markdown.description: The full formatted answer to show the user, exactly as it would otherwise be written in plain text/markdown.

winner.description: If this response identifies a single cheapest/best provider to complete a real-world booking or purchase on, describe it here so a direct link to that provider can be built. Otherwise set provider to 'none'.

provider.description: The winning provider's key. Use 'none' if this response isn't a comparison with a bookable winner.

query.description: For shopping/food providers: the product name or dish/restaurant to search for on the winning provider's site.

pickup.description: For ride providers only: the pickup location.

drop.description: For ride providers only: the destination.
